# Two parties agree on terms. We propose them; the customer signs (in person
# above HKD 1,000,000) before the start date; we countersign, and the terms
# are effective until we close them with the customer's consent. Amendments
# need the customer's consent too, and only while the terms are proposed.
contract Agreement
parties we, customer

record Terms
  terms text
  amount HKD
  starts date

can amend by we with new_amount HKD, new_start date
  requires proposed
  requires consent of customer
  requires new_amount > HKD 0
  if new_amount > amount * 150%
    reject "an amendment may raise the amount by half at most"
  otherwise
    amount = new_amount
  starts = new_start
can sign by customer
  over 1_000_000 requires in person
  requires now < starts
  proposed -> signed
can countersign by we
  signed -> effective
can close by we
  requires consent of customer
  effective -> closed

test "signed in person, countersigned, and closed"
  we create at 2026-10-14 with terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", amount = HKD 1_500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  we amend with new_amount = HKD 2_000_000, new_start = 2027-01-08 -> proposed
  customer sign -> refused "bo:in-person sign"
  customer sign in person -> signed
  we amend with new_amount = HKD 1, new_start = 2027-01-08 -> refused "bo:requires amend 1"
  we countersign -> effective
  we close at 2027-06-30 -> closed
  we close -> refused

test "what one party cannot do alone"
  we create with terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", amount = HKD 500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  we amend with new_amount = HKD 600_000, new_start = 2027-01-01 -> consent of customer
  we amend with new_amount = HKD 900_000, new_start = 2027-01-01
  -> refused "an amendment may raise the amount by half at most"
  we sign -> consent of customer
  customer countersign -> refused "bo:state countersign"
  customer sign by AI agent -> signed
  customer countersign -> consent of we
  we close -> refused "bo:state close"

test "too late to sign"
  we create with terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", amount = HKD 500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  customer sign at 2027-01-02 -> refused "bo:requires sign 2"

# 雙方就條款達成協議。本公司提出條款；客戶於開始日期前簽署（金額超過港元
# 1,000,000 須親身確認）；本公司加簽後條款生效，直至本公司經客戶同意終結。
# 修訂亦須經客戶同意，且只限於條款仍屬已提議期間。
合約 Agreement
訂約方 本公司, 客戶

紀錄 Terms
  terms 文字
  金額 港元
  starts 日期

可 amend 由 本公司 連同 new_amount 港元, new_start 日期
  須 已提議
  須 經 客戶 同意
  須 new_amount > 港元 0
  如 new_amount > 金額 * 150%
    拒絕 "an amendment may raise the amount by half at most"
  否則
    金額 = new_amount
  starts = new_start
可 sign 由 客戶
  超過 1_000_000 須親身確認
  須 現時 < starts
  已提議 -> signed
可 countersign 由 本公司
  signed -> effective
可 close 由 本公司
  須 經 客戶 同意
  effective -> closed

測試 "signed in person, countersigned, and closed"
  本公司 建立 時間 2026-10-14 連同 terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", 金額 = 港元 1_500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  本公司 amend 連同 new_amount = 港元 2_000_000, new_start = 2027-01-08 -> 已提議
  客戶 sign -> 被拒絕 "bo:in-person sign"
  客戶 sign 親身確認 -> signed
  本公司 amend 連同 new_amount = 港元 1, new_start = 2027-01-08 -> 被拒絕 "bo:requires amend 1"
  本公司 countersign -> effective
  本公司 close 時間 2027-06-30 -> closed
  本公司 close -> 被拒絕

測試 "what one party cannot do alone"
  本公司 建立 連同 terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", 金額 = 港元 500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  本公司 amend 連同 new_amount = 港元 600_000, new_start = 2027-01-01 -> 經 客戶 同意
  本公司 amend 連同 new_amount = 港元 900_000, new_start = 2027-01-01
  -> 被拒絕 "an amendment may raise the amount by half at most"
  本公司 sign -> 經 客戶 同意
  客戶 countersign -> 被拒絕 "bo:state countersign"
  客戶 sign 由 AI 代理 -> signed
  客戶 countersign -> 經 本公司 同意
  本公司 close -> 被拒絕 "bo:state close"

測試 "too late to sign"
  本公司 建立 連同 terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", 金額 = 港元 500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  客戶 sign 時間 2027-01-02 -> 被拒絕 "bo:requires sign 2"

# 双方就条款达成协议。本公司提出条款；客户在开始日期前签署（金额超过港元
# 1,000,000 须本人确认）；本公司加签后条款生效，直至本公司经客户同意终结。
# 修订也须经客户同意，且只限于条款仍为已提议期间。
合约 Agreement
参与方 本公司、客户

记录 Terms
  terms 文本
  金额 港元
  starts 日期

可 amend 由 本公司 附带 new_amount 港元, new_start 日期
  须 已提议
  须 经 客户 同意
  须 new_amount > 港元 0
  如果 new_amount > 金额 * 150%
    拒绝 "an amendment may raise the amount by half at most"
  否则
    金额 = new_amount
  starts = new_start
可 sign 由 客户
  超过 1_000_000 须本人确认
  须 现在 < starts
  已提议 -> signed
可 countersign 由 本公司
  signed -> effective
可 close 由 本公司
  须 经 客户 同意
  effective -> closed

测试 "signed in person, countersigned, and closed"
  本公司 创建 时间 2026-10-14 附带 terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", 金额 = 港元 1_500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  本公司 amend 附带 new_amount = 港元 2_000_000, new_start = 2027-01-08 -> 已提议
  客户 sign -> 被拒绝 "bo:in-person sign"
  客户 sign 本人确认 -> signed
  本公司 amend 附带 new_amount = 港元 1, new_start = 2027-01-08 -> 被拒绝 "bo:requires amend 1"
  本公司 countersign -> effective
  本公司 close 时间 2027-06-30 -> closed
  本公司 close -> 被拒绝

测试 "what one party cannot do alone"
  本公司 创建 附带 terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", 金额 = 港元 500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  本公司 amend 附带 new_amount = 港元 600_000, new_start = 2027-01-01 -> 经 客户 同意
  本公司 amend 附带 new_amount = 港元 900_000, new_start = 2027-01-01
  -> 被拒绝 "an amendment may raise the amount by half at most"
  本公司 sign -> 经 客户 同意
  客户 countersign -> 被拒绝 "bo:state countersign"
  客户 sign 由 AI 代理 -> signed
  客户 countersign -> 经 本公司 同意
  本公司 close -> 被拒绝 "bo:state close"

测试 "too late to sign"
  本公司 创建 附带 terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", 金额 = 港元 500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  客户 sign 时间 2027-01-02 -> 被拒绝 "bo:requires sign 2"

contract Loan
parties we, bank

record Note
  amount HKD
  holder we

can lend by we to bank
  holder = bank
can repay by bank
  requires holder = bank
  holder = we

contract Values
parties we, customer

record Sheet
  label text
  approved yes or no
  total HKD
  ends date
  share 10%
  grace 30 days
  cap HKD 1_000

can fill by we with unit_price HKD, units number, note text, ok yes or no, from_day date
  requires units > 0 and ok = yes
  requires note = label or note = "any"
  total = unit_price * units
  requires total / units = unit_price
  ends = from_day + 3 months
  if ends - from_day > 100 days
    reject "too long"
  approved = total * share > cap
  label = note
can adjust by we with part HKD, whole HKD
  requires part / whole < 50%
  total = part + whole - cap
  ends = ends + grace - 1 month
  if today > ends or not approved
    reject "late"

# Two parties agree on terms: the customer signs, with our consent, and we
# close. The first state is the one no state change leads to (R4).
contract Agreement
parties we, customer

record Terms
  terms text
  price HKD

can sign by customer
  requires consent of we
  proposed -> signed
can close by we
  signed -> closed

test "signed and closed"
  we create with terms = "steel", price = HKD 100
  customer sign -> signed
  we close -> closed

test "the customer cannot close"
  we create with terms = "steel", price = HKD 100
  customer close -> refused "bo:state close"
  customer sign -> signed
  customer close -> consent of we

test "the customer cannot close" step 2, call 1
test "the customer cannot close" step 3, call 1
test "the customer cannot close" step 3, call 2
test "the customer cannot close" step 4, call 1

# Tests that fail, and how bo test says so: a step that ends in another
# state, a refusal that does not come, a consent nobody asks for, another
# reason; a test stops at its first failing step.
contract Deal
parties we, customer

record Terms
  price HKD

can accept by customer
  requires price > HKD 0
  proposed -> accepted
can withdraw by we
  if price > HKD 1_000
    reject "too large to withdraw"
  proposed -> withdrawn

test "accepted, not withdrawn"
  we create with price = HKD 500
  customer accept -> withdrawn
  we withdraw

test "nothing to refuse"
  we create with price = HKD 500
  we withdraw -> refused "too large to withdraw"

test "a consent nobody asks for"
  we create with price = HKD 5_000
  customer accept -> consent of bank1

test "another reason"
  we create with price = HKD 5_000
  we withdraw -> refused "bo:state withdraw"

test
  we create with price = HKD 5_000
  customer accept

runs.label: test "a consent nobody asks for" step 1, call 1
test "a consent nobody asks for" step 2, call 1
test "a consent nobody asks for" step 2, call 2

# Test blocks: steps, their signers and times, and what each expects. The
# bank is bound by the first loan, to a ledger only the tests name (bank1).
contract Loan
parties we, customer, bank

record Note
  amount HKD
  holder customer

can lend by we to bank
  requires consent of customer
  proposed -> lent
can repay by bank
  requires holder = customer
  lent -> repaid

test "lent and repaid"
  we create with amount = HKD 1_000
  we lend to bank1 at 2027-01-06 in person -> lent
  bank1 repay by AI agent
  -> repaid

test unhappy
  we create at 2027-01-06 with amount = HKD 1_000
  we lend to bank1 -> consent of (customer, bank1)
  bank1 repay -> refused "bo:party bank"
  customer lend to bank1 -> consent of we
  we lend to bank1 -> lent
  we lend to bank1 -> refused

# A supply agreement between a core enterprise (we), its supplier, and its
# bank. We propose the terms; they take effect once the supplier and the
# bank have both consented, each on its own ledger; we close the agreement
# once the supplier confirms that the goods were delivered.
contract SupplyAgreement
parties we, supplier, bank

record Terms
  goods text
  pieces number
  price CNY
  deliver_by date

can sign by we
  requires consent of supplier
  requires consent of bank
  proposed -> signed
can close by we
  requires consent of supplier
  signed -> closed

# Its tests: bo test runs each on an instance of its own, as the ledger would.
test "signed by all three, then closed"
  we create at 2026-10-12 with goods = "Bearings 6204-2RS", pieces = 20_000, price = CNY 1_250_000, deliver_by = 2026-12-01
  we sign -> signed
  we close at 2026-12-01 -> closed

test "nobody signs alone"
  we create with goods = "Bearings 6204-2RS", pieces = 20_000, price = CNY 1_250_000, deliver_by = 2026-12-01
  we sign -> consent of bank
  supplier sign -> consent of we
  we close -> refused "bo:state close"

runs.label: test "signed by all three, then closed" step 1, call 1
test "signed by all three, then closed" step 2, call 1
test "signed by all three, then closed" step 2, call 2
test "signed by all three, then closed" step 3, call 1
test "signed by all three, then closed" step 3, call 2
